extracted.intended_audience: Congressional staff, Department of the Interior and Treasury accountants and officials, Indian agents, and policymakers responsible for Indian trust funds and land administration
extracted.subtask_description: Establishing and presenting required legal authorizations and detailed financial statements for Indian trust funds and trust lands (bonds, stocks, interest, funds held in lieu of investment) in the United States Government annual report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confirmation and certification of lands selected by State of Kansas
rubrics_metrics.description: Resolved ... That the lands so selected by the State of Kansas be, and the same are hereby, confirmed to said State; and the Secretary of the Interior be, and hereby is, authorized to certify the same to said State, in lieu of sections sixteen and thirty-six, sold and disposed of by the United States, within the limits of any former Indian reservation as aforesaid.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legal authorization requires confirmation of State-selected lands and a certification by the Secretary of the Interior substituting such selections in lieu of sections 16 and 36 where those sections were previously sold/disposed of within former Indian reservations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorization to sue in Court of Claims (Elias C. Boudinot)
rubrics_metrics.description: Be it enacted ... That ... Elias C. Boudinot ... be ... authorized to bring suit in the Court of Claims against the United States Government, to recover what may be due to him in justice and equity for the loss inflicted upon him by reason of said seizure for an alleged violation of the internal-revenue laws, of his property, a tobacco factory, its detention, and damage thereto whilst under seizure, the value of the tobacco, material, and other personal property also seized, and the expenses to which he was subjected thereby.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Congressional act grants an individual right to seek relief in the Court of Claims for property seizure/damages arising from alleged violations; the act specifies subject matter (property, factory, goods, detention, damages, expenses).

rubrics_metrics.name: Treasury payment / Interior annuity deduction authorization (Henry Warren)
rubrics_metrics.description: That the Secretary of the Treasury of the United States be ... authorized and directed to pay Henry Warren ... the sum of fifteen thousand eight hundred and sixty-seven dollars and fifty cents ... in full satisfaction for damages sustained ... and that the Secretary of the Interior be ... directed to retain, out of any annuities due or to become due the Comanche and Kiowa Indians, the sum of eleven thousand eight hundred and fifty-two dollars and fifty cents, and from any annuities due or to become due the Cheyennes the sum of four thousand and fifteen dollars, and cover the same into the Treasury in accordance with treaty stipulations between said Indian tribes and the United States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Act prescribes both a direct Treasury payment to a claimant and an offset mechanism by directing Interior to withhold specified amounts from tribal annuities and remit to the Treasury, pursuant to treaty obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proclamation enforcing occupancy/intercourse laws in Indian Territory
rubrics_metrics.description: The President admonishes and warns all such persons ... against any attempt to so remove or settle upon any of the lands of said Territory; and ... they will be speedily and immediately removed therefrom by the agent, according to the laws made and provided, and that ... the aid and assistance of the military forces of the United States will be invoked to carry into proper execution the laws of the United States herein referred to.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Executive proclamation reiterates that Indian Territory is subject to occupancy restrictions under treaties and intercourse laws; agents may remove unauthorized persons and military force may be used to enforce the laws.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual reporting requirement for Indian trust funds and trust lands
rubrics_metrics.description: The following statements show the transactions in the Indian trust funds and trust lands during the year ending October 31, 1880 :
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The annual report must present consolidated statements that enable 'a proper understanding of the subject' and document transactions for the fiscal year ending Oct 31, 1880.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement No. 1 — Bonds sold and redeemed reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Statement showing the sale and redemption of bonds since November 1, 1879, and amounts deposited in the Treasury in lieu of investment under act approved April 1, 1880.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report must list kind of bonds, fund or tribe, date of sale and redemption, and amount sold and redeemed; identify amounts deposited in the Treasury 'in lieu of investment' under the specified act.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recapitulation of bonds held in trust
rubrics_metrics.description: Recapitulation showing the aggregate of bonds held in trust for various Indian tribes November 1, 1880: Whole amount of bonds on hand November 1, 1879; Amount of bonds sold and redeemed; Total on hand November 1, 1880.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide opening balance, disposals/sales, and closing balance for bonds held in trust to give aggregate reconciliation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement A — List of tribes and stock credits
rubrics_metrics.description: List of names of Indian tribes for whom stock is held in trust by the Treasurer of the United States, showing the amount standing to the credit of each tribe, the annual interest, the date of treaty or law under which the investment was made, and the amount of abstracted bonds for which Congress has made no appropriation, and the annual interest on the same.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This statement must include per-tribe: tribe name, treaty/act citation (Statutes at Large vol. and page), amount of stock, annual interest, amount of abstracted (unprovided) bonds, and annual interest on those abstracted bonds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement B — Detailed stock account and securities
rubrics_metrics.description: Statement of stock account, exhibiting in detail the securities in which the funds of each tribe are invested and now on hand, the annual interest on the same, and the amount of abstracted bonds not provided for by Congress.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each tribal fund list the specific securities (state issues, U.S. loans, railroad issues), percent, original amount, amount on hand, and annual interest; indicate any abstracted bonds and whether Congress provided for them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement C — Consolidated stocks held in trust
rubrics_metrics.description: Statement of stocks held by the Treasurer of the United States in trust for the various Indian tribes, showing the amount now on hand: also abstracted bonds, for which Congress has made no appropriation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a consolidated schedule (by security type) of amounts on hand and note total abstracted bonds outstanding without Congressional appropriation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement D — Funds held in trust in lieu of investment
rubrics_metrics.description: Statement of funds held in trust by the government in lieu of investment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List tribal funds held as cash balances in the Treasury instead of invested securities, with amounts and the annual interest rate equivalent (e.g., interest at 4 or 5 percent) and indicate statutes/treaties authorizing such holdings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement D No.2 — Funds held in lieu of abstracted bonds
rubrics_metrics.description: Funds held in the government in lieu of abstracted bonds. (Tribes; date of acts, resolutions, or treaties; Statutes at Large citation; amount in the United States Treasury.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reconcile funds held as substitutes for abstracted bonds, with statutory citations and Treasury balances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement E — Interest collected on United States bonds
rubrics_metrics.description: Interest collected on United States bonds: for each fund or tribe show face of bonds, period for which interest was collected, and interest amount.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report must itemize per fund/tribe: the face value of bonds, the exact interest periods (dates), interest amounts collected, and any premiums realized on sales; present periodic interest receipts to support income accounting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconciliation of increases and decreases in funds held in lieu of investment
rubrics_metrics.description: The changes in the account of funds held in lieu of investment are accounted for as follows, viz: This fund has been increased by [proceeds of sales, uninvested balances, payments, appropriations] ... This fund has been decreased by [reimbursements, payments, etc.].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a detailed reconciliation listing each source of increase (proceeds of sales, appropriations, payments set aside) and each decrease (reimbursements, payments for surveys, erroneous sales corrections) with amounts, so net increase (or decrease) is traceable to line items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Detailed per-security disclosure for tribal funds
rubrics_metrics.description: For each tribal fund disclose the exact securities held (State issues, United States funded loans, United States issues to Union Pacific Railroad, etc.), their per cent, and the amount on hand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tabulate for each security type the par amount, percent, and per-tribe allocation to show composition of invested tribal funds and enable interest calculation.
